name: Harper Hygienics S.A.
summary: Harper Hygienics S.A., established in Warsaw, Poland, in 1990, is a prominent manufacturer and global distributor of cosmetic and hygienic personal care items. The company's diverse product line caters to women, infants, and children, reaching markets both within Poland and internationally. Their extensive portfolio includes a variety of offerings such as cotton swabs, makeup removers (both pads and wipes), specialized cosmetic buds, and a broad selection of wet wipes, including refreshing, baby, intimate hygiene, and general hand and body wipes. They also provide various disposable wet wipes, cosmetic pads, and hygienic buds. Beyond personal care, Harper Hygienics manufactures specialized cleaning wipes for a range of surfaces like kitchens, bathrooms, windows, mirrors, wooden furniture, anti-electrostatic surfaces, and leather furniture. Other key products comprise nail polish remover pads, cotton pads, and wet tissues. These items are marketed under their proprietary brand names, which include Sweet Sense, Cleanic, Cleanic Kindii, Presto Clean, Nieznost, and Ola, and are also supplied to retail chains under private label agreements.
